text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? ...What's this strange form? If I try

interpreting it, it seems to mean that in
the near
future...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(A light will come my way—a huge
vortex of light.
But that vortex...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(It has a little darkness in the center. It's
a bit like
a donut of light.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not sensing any ill will from it.
The good
aspects are way more
prevalent.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Good fortune is right around the corner!
Better
luck than I've ever experienced in
my life is on the
way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The uproarious tide of luck comes all of
a sudden,
engulfing Copano Rickey and
her entire life with
it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey! Please give me a
moment of your
time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Trainer, why are there so many
people here?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Please tell us all about feng shui!
Recently, we've
had multiple requests
from readers who want to
know more!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Would you be interested in
appearing
on TV? We'd like to have you
on our show to
discuss feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: On TV?! Trainer, what's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like the incident at the
Japanese Derby
is what finally sparked
this firestorm of attention.
choice_data_list: ああ、風水人気に火がついたようだな
うん、風水人気に火がついたみたい
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, looks like feng shui really took off.
Yeah, looks like feng shui is really catching on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui—a factor that has been
entirely absent
from the Twinkle Series
until now—is starting to
pique
everyone's curiosity.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Then that means I did it!
Everyone finally
understands what makes
feng shui so great!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I-I can say yes to all of these offers,
right? Right?!
I'll never get another
super-mega opportunity like
this! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Copano Rickey, this is a dream come
true.
And...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Rickey? What's with all the
commotion?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, Tarumae. Sorry. I'm in your way,
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But check out how many folks came from
all these
media outlets! They're all eager
to learn about
feng shui! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Well... I don't really get it, but just
try not to
go off on too many detours,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Don't let the media sap all your time and energy, or it'll affect your training.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know you push yourself too hard,
Rickey, so just
make sure you look after
yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I have to go! My prep plan for the
Teio Sho is
calling...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The Teio Sho?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a G1 dirt race held in Oi. I
have to
make sure I do well there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Copano Rickey and Hokko
Tarumae set
about working hard to
reach their own goals.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What's next on the schedule
again?! The
lecture? The meeting with
the publisher?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, that comes first! I sure hope
we make it
in time.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Taxi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae, on the other hand...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on a fantastic Teio Sho
victory,
Hokko Tarumae! We also saw a
brilliant
performance from Wonder
Acute, who came in
third.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae, as the new dirt
champion of the
first half of the season,
would you mind sharing a
few words for
the camera?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A few words for the camera? Whew,
fantastic...
Now I can finally talk about
my hometown!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
My name's Hokko Tarumae and I'm
Tomakomai's
tourism ambassador! I hope
I can count on
everyone's support!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The days fly by, and then, during one
particular
TV appearance...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Rickey, the feng shui boom has arrived. Feng shui is all the rage right now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm so happy everyone's finally
learning
about it. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And to help everyone learn even more...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'm going to use my feng shui
power in a
race against Tarumae. ☆
We'll be competing in
the Champions
Cup at the end of the year!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
You're referring to the Hokko Tarumae
who won
the Teio Sho, yes? This is
bound to be an intense
bout!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For sure! If I run well in that race, I
should be able
to spread feng shui even
further!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. You know, I'm not sure there's
anyone left
out there who doesn't know
about feng shui. Its
current popularity is
unprecedented.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
In any case, we're all looking forward to
the race.
Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(There's no one left who doesn't know
about feng
shui... Wow. This has been
my goal all along...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(And the word's already spread that far,
huh. I
guess I'm pretty close to making
my dream come
true.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We sure didn't see any of this coming,
huh? First
the Japanese Derby and now
this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No one ever paid any attention to feng
shui, so
it's wild to see it suddenly
become this huge
thing. If this keeps
up...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. The reason I run is to get
everyone
to believe in the power of feng
shui and be
happy, so...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If everyone already believes in feng shui,
then
what would I be racing for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't have an answer for her. If Copano
Rickey's
dream really has come true,
then you could say
she's already at the
finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if that's the case, would it mean she
has no
reason to race anymore? She's
already achieved
everything she ever
hoped to accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep-beep, beep-beep, beep-beep...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh! My alarm! I almost forgot! It's time
for my
next TV interview!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! Now's not the time to
be
thinking about this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what the future will bring,
but for
now, we just need to keep
moving forward with
all the momentum
we can muster.
